summary: Describes the release candidate process: RC1 lasts about five business days, RC2 about two business days, and further RCs follow until major problems are resolved.
questions: How long does an Ansible release candidate last?
Can I test a new Ansible release before it is final?
What happens if bugs are found in a release candidate?

answer_card.title: Release candidate process
answer_card.answer_md:
At least one release candidate precedes each major release of Ansible or ansible-core, so the community can test playbooks and report bugs.

- **RC1** usually lasts five business days; with no major issues it becomes the final release.
- If problems are found, they are fixed and **RC2** is tagged; after two business days with no problems it becomes final.
- Further RCs follow until maintainers agree all major problems are fixed.
